venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Same first step. Different answer. Baugh is the night. Woods is the lever. The hitch is the tax.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — first drives sat with Charles. Later snaps sat off the condensed cut and scoring clips. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner sequences the line so you cannot sit on Baugh. White moves Woods so the tackle never gets a clean count.

offense.body:
The picture keeps changing. The answers stay simple. Baugh is the night. The line is how they keep you from sitting on him.

What stood out

Read game: two tight ends, H-back off the line. Read. Give. Baugh, 9. Next snap, same family. The line washes right. Baugh cuts left, 8. Same play, other hole.

Counter-to-screen: Brown in motion, four yards deep. Tackles pull like it is counter. Interior three release the other way. The ball goes to Brown — to the three, not the pullers. FAU stepped with the pullers. That is the design.

Same family later: pullers one way, three big people out in the flat the other way, Philo sells the first look. Clark’s 10-yard score — they throw it to the back and the interior is already down the field on the boundary. Get the big people out in front of a skill player.

Pistol in the opening script: H-back, three wide. Run on second-and-2. Same set, play-action, Wilson sits under the zone, 19. Pistol is one look. It is not the offense.

Motion, counter, keep: tackles one way, motion the other. The end crashes. Philo keeps it. Sledge is still there. Minus 2. The design was sound. FAU won the snap.

The punch when the pull is real: Baugh, 12, the pullers lead and he hits it. Short field: Baugh 18, Stockton catch at the 11, he walks in. Brown as the runner, 14. Fourth-and-1 sneak. Philo, 3, they stay on the field. Harpring, 19, in the middle. Baugh, 7, punch. Stockton, 8. Baugh, 61, when the whole stadium knows. Baugh, 6, punch. Clark, 28, then 4.

The shot: Abrams 63 when they crowd the run. The line is in a pass set. He throws it over the top. Brown is not a gadget — the screen, the 49, the 14, the 33, the 18. Wilson moves the chains all night — 19, 15, 13.

Identity on tape

It is sequenced. He changes the picture, not the rules. Same first step, three answers.

One snap is the read.
Next is the counter-screen, interior leaving.
Next is the pistol run.
Next is the pistol sit.
Next is motion and the keep.
Next is the shot when they crowd the box.
Next is the sneak when they expect movement.
Next is the wash-and-cut when they overplay the pull.
Next is the punch when the pull is real.
Next is the big people out in front of Clark.

Every look sets up the next look. Every lie sets up the truth. Every truth sets up the lie.

Defenses cannot sit on Baugh because the line keeps changing the picture. Pullers one way, interior the other. Motion behind it. Same first step, different answer. Pass set when they crowd the run. Sneak when they expect counter. Make them wrong before the ball is snapped.

What to clean

The keep when Sledge crashes and is still there.
The snap that loses twenty inside the five.
The ball off Mays.
Real. Not the night.
bullets: Same first step, three answers: the screen, the punch, the sneak.
Tackles sell counter. Interior three leave. Ball goes with the three — Brown, later Clark.
When the pull is real, Baugh hits it. When they need a yard, nobody leaves.
Abrams 63 is the pass set. Clean the Sledge keep, the snap, and the ball off Mays.

defense.body:
White’s defense is odd fronts, movement, and disguising the JACK. He mixes looks often — not every snap — enough that FAU’s line never gets a clean count.

What stood out

Woods is the lever. On third down White moves him. On the ball, he is the edge. Off the ball, the edge belongs to somebody else and Woods is coming or dropping from a different spot. That is a better rush lane without telling the tackle who has him.

Third-and-7: Woods in a backer, press, comeback to Henry, they convert.
Third-and-1: Woods off, nickel on the line, corners off, hitch to Valsin, they convert.
Later: Woods in the run fit — Ervin, Farrow — when they try to stay on schedule.

Front variety: 3-3-5 with the JACK standing. Wide front, both edges up, stunt. Shade front — three down to one side, Woods and a linebacker in the other gap. The line cannot sit on one count.

Coverage mixes with the front.
Press on third-and-7 — comeback beats McClain.
Off, nickel on the line, third-and-1 — hitch converts.
One-high, corners off, early down — Chiles fills the short middle, three yards, they win the snap.
Same family, wide stunt — Valsin converts. The hitch is the tax.
Third-and-10: shade, press one side, off the other. Coleman opens to the middle, sells the hole, the ball goes outside, Coleman is already back to the receiver. That is the pick. Not a blitz. He moved the quarterback’s eyes. Johnson’s pick is the same family.

The short-game tax

FAU lived on the hitch, the comeback, and the sit — five to eight yards at a time. White plays off a lot. When the stunt does not get home, that throw is there. That is ninety snaps.

What looked good

Coleman’s bait. Johnson’s pick. Bett stripping the keep at the 1. McCloud taking fourth-and-2. James stopping Ervin to end the half. Chiles on the short middle. Lyons and Flowers in the backfield. Woods when he is asked to tackle.

What leaked

Henry and Valsin taking what was given.
The pile at the 1.
The edge leaving and Veltkamp walking in.
The fade when the corner is off.
Hoch on fourth down.
Sit on the hitch. Keep the edge when the quarterback keeps it.
bullets: 3-3-5, spaced, shaded. Woods is the lever on third down.
Coleman sells middle, takes outside. Johnson’s pick is the same family.
They play off a lot. The hitch is the tax. Ninety snaps.
Clean the pile, the edge, the fade, Hoch on fourth.

specials.body: The drive stalls. They take the points. Durkin from 53. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt is how the second Florida score starts.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt sets up the short field.

keys: Offense: sequenced. Same first step, different answer. FAU never gets set.
Defense: odd fronts, Woods on third down, disguise. Not every snap. Often.
FAU’s night is the hitch until somebody sits on it.
Florida’s payoff: make him hold it. Coleman’s pick.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and keep it. Florida will still run Baugh and dress the line — pullers one way, interior the other. The counter-screen family will show up again. White has to sit on the hitch and keep Woods’ edge home when the quarterback pulls it.
